content:
incident-bot: 🚨 INC-472 detected: elevated paging and KV cache growth on prod-cluster-3. Triggered by batch-scheduler latency spike. Paging rate up 4x, io-wait rising. Paging alerts: /alerts/paging-high

maya_k: I'm on it. seeing big bumps in kv_cache.entries and concurrent batches. Noticing a lot of long requests mixed with short ones.

maya_k: quick snapshot: `kv_cache.size_bytes` went 3x in 3m, `batch_queue.length` spiked to 240, p50->p99 token latency cliffed.

alex_ryan: are we sure this is cache blowup vs memory leak? any correlation with a deploy?

maya_k: no deploys in last 30m. looks like a recent planner change to continuous-batching heuristics might be the culprit — it started aggressively batching prefixes which increases KV residency.

pranav.s: @maya_k can you paste the scheduler metrics? curious about fairness counters (long_vs_short preemption).

maya_k: pasted: ```
# batch_scheduler.metrics
mixed_request_ratio: 0.42
long_request_preemptions: 1
short_request_starvation_count: 312
continuous_batch_window_ms: 250
kv_cache.evictions/sec: 4.2
kv_cache.miss_rate: 0.06
cpu_pressure: 78%
io_wait: 34%
```

jess_prod: customers may see 502s on multi-turn chat endpoints if KV pages thrash. Any impacted customers flagged?

maya_k: flagged two high-traffic tenants (tenant-a, tenant-b). Grace periods applied. Support pinged.

oncall_bot: Paging mitigation runbook step 1: reduce continuous_batch_window and enable kv eviction throttle.

maya_k: proposing immediate mitigation: reduce `continuous_batch_window_ms` from 250 -> 40, and set `kv_cache.eviction_target_ratio` to 0.8 to force more evictions. Also enable short-request prioritization in scheduler.

ben_platform: +1 to fast change; low risk config tweak. Can we hotpatch on rack-3 first and observe?

maya_k: doing canary on rack-3 now: `curl -XPOST http://orchestrator/api/config -d '{"continuous_batch_window_ms":40,"short_first_priority":true}'`

incident-bot: deploybot: canary apply succeeded on rack-3 (3/3 nodes). Monitoring 2m.

maya_k: early signs good — batch_queue.length down to 60, kv_cache.size_bytes dropping, io_wait trending down. p99 token latency improved ~600ms.

pranav.s: start rolling to remaining racks with 30s pause between racks. Keep quick rollback plan: restore window=250 if anything bad.

alex_ryan: heads up: short_request_starvation_count went from 312 -> 28 after canary. Great.

maya_k: rolling now. patch applied to all racks.

incident-bot: deploybot: rollout succeeded cluster-wide.

jess_prod: support: sent customer note to tenant-a/tenant-b, no escalations yet.

maya_k: verifying KB pages: `sudo slabtop -o` shows stable memory slabs, and `iostat` shows iowait back to baseline.

pranav.s: good. want to leave short-first enabled for 12h then evaluate. We should also revert any planner heuristic that started this path.

ben_platform: opened ENG-987 to track longer fix: revert batching heuristic change + add canary gating on cache growth metrics.

maya_k: adding post-incident metrics to the incident doc: token-latency p50/p95/p99 before/after, cache size, eviction rates, paging ops.

oncall_bot: Handoff: @pranav.s you are primary oncall for the next 8 hours. Confirm?

pranav.s: confirmed. will monitor dashboards and follow up with a postmortem template.

alex_ryan: quick note: we'll add an alert for `continuous_batch_window_ms` drift and a synthetic test with mixed long/short workload to catch regressions.

jess_prod: tagging PM & CSMs so they can prepare comms if customer impact resurfaces.

maya_k: final notes: root cause: continuous-batching heuristic started joining long and short requests without preemption, creating oversized batches that evicted more KV entries and increased paging. Mitigation: reduced batch window, short-first scheduling, eviction tuning. Followups: rollback heuristic change, add canary gating, expand e2e test.

incident-bot: INC-472 transitioned to status: mitigated. Postmortem assigned to @maya_k and @pranav.s.

pranav.s: filing postmortem now, will include timeline, metrics, and remediation plan.

maya_k: thanks all for fast responses :thumbsup: keeping an eye on dashboards for the next 6h.

incident-bot: reminder: create RCA within 72h and link to ENG-987.
